overview: The board approved a special permit and revised site plan for a mixed-use building at 290 Salem Street and approved amended site plans for the Great American Beer Hall at 142 Mystic Avenue. Staff also briefed the board on the timeline and contents of upcoming citywide zoning recodification proposals.

items.title: 290 Salem Street site plan review and special permit
items.summary: Approved the site plan review and special permit for a three-story mixed-use building with seven residential units and ground-floor commercial space, with conditions restricting tenant access to residential street parking permits and delegating minor aesthetic changes to planning staff.

items.title: 142 Mystic Avenue (Great American Beer Hall) site plan amendment
items.summary: Approved modifications to the site layout, access drive, and circulation necessitated by MassDOT permit requirements, conditioning the approval on internal safety signage, exploring rear access to Route 16, and collaborating with city staff on neighborhood traffic calming.

items.title: Approval of minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from May 1, 2024.

items.title: Zoning overhaul updates
items.summary: Planning Director Alicia Hunt outlined the City Council's upcoming schedule for initial zoning recodification packages, including baseline definitions, consolidated use and parking tables, and Dover Amendment-style exemptions for municipal buildings.
